title: From Capturing a Lead to the Opportunity and the Follow-Up

sections.label: 1 - CAPTURING THE LEAD
sections.note: This covers your forms, surveys, calendars and lead capture, and your tags, custom fields, triggers and actions. A form or survey starts everything, the lead gets a source tag and field, and the team is told.

sections.label: 2 - MANAGING THE OPPORTUNITY
sections.note: This covers your pipelines and opportunity stages and connecting leads to the right pipeline. Every lead opens at New Lead so the stage always shows where it stands.

sections.label: 3 - AUTOMATING THE FOLLOW-UP
sections.note: This covers your workflows, automated follow-ups and email and SMS automation.

sections.label: 4 - STOP WHEN THEY REPLY
sections.note: A small second workflow catches any reply, moves the opportunity to Replied and tags the lead so the follow-up stops wherever it is.

sections.label: 5 - STOP WHEN THEY BOOK ON THE CALENDAR
sections.note: A third workflow fires on the calendar booking, moves the opportunity to Call Booked and stops the follow-up the same way.

nodes.label: 1 - Lead Capture Form Submitted
nodes.notes: The form sits on your funnel's landing page. Swap the filter for a survey and the rest of the workflow stays the same.

nodes.label: 2 - Tag the Contact lead-form
nodes.notes: Two tags in the whole system: this source tag and lead-engaged. The pipeline stage carries the status, not a pile of tags.

nodes.notes: This is where the lead is connected to the appropriate pipeline and follow-up sequence.

params.message: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, {{user.first_name}} again from {{location.name}}. Still happy to help with what you asked about. Here's the link to pick a time: {{custom_values.booking_link}}
